metadata.description: forge — a stage-by-stage workflow skill set (fg-*) for the ask·plan → execute → retro → cleanup loop.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Four fg-* skills that take one task through a single cycle of ask·plan → execute → retro → cleanup. Ask·plan is grill-with-docs-style conversational grilling, execute picks a task from the backlog (Run all supported) and runs it as a Dynamic Workflow, retro promotes learnings to docs, and cleanup seals the task and guards against re-runs.
